subject.title: [Feature]: Relocating status footer on intermediate channel messages during active runs

question: Should durable intermediate-message status use a new default-on `messages.statusFooter` surface, or be opt-in and unified with the existing streaming progress controls?
rationale: Both approaches can address the visibility gap, but the choice changes defaults, configuration, channel-edit traffic, and the relationship between transient previews and durable messages.

options.title: Unify and start opt-in
options.body: Reuse the existing progress-mode policy and initially enable durable relocation only through an explicit setting on edit-capable channels.

options.title: Accept the proposed default
options.body: Ship `messages.statusFooter` with `activity` as the default after proving clean coexistence with previews and safe upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep transient previews only
options.body: Decline durable-message decoration and improve discoverability of the existing progress-preview behavior instead.

recommendation.title: Unify and start opt-in
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing progress-mode policy and initially enable durable relocation only through an explicit setting on edit-capable channels.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal and linked implementation originate with this person, making them the strongest available owner for resolving the intended product shape.
